title: Unsupervised Latent Space Alignment with Hyperspherical Geodesic Matching
abstract: arXiv:2608.28840v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Independently trained neural networks tend to encode the same data with similar latent geometries. These latent geometries are not directly compatible, yet they can be nearly the same up to some class of transformations. While there exists many methods for alignment between different latent spaces, it is typically done using a set of shared sample correspondences, known as anchors. This leaves a fundamental question: are the geometric signatures of different latent spaces representing similar data sufficient to recover an alignment between them? To that end, we introduce HGA (Hyperspherical Gaussian Alignment), a method that directly optimizes a transformation between two latent spaces by maximizing a geometric measure of "fit" between them. Since it is driven by the geometry of the latent spaces rather than paired data, HGA can operate in both an unsupervised and weakly supervised regime. On tasks such as model stitching or multilingual

translated_title: 无监督潜空间对齐与超球面测地线匹配
translated_abstract: 独立训练的神经网络往往以相似的潜在几何结构对相同数据进行编码。这些潜在几何结构并不直接兼容，但它们在经过某类变换后可能几乎相同。虽然目前已存在许多潜空间之间进行对齐的方法，但它们通常需要一组共享的样本对应关系，即锚点。这就留下了一个根本性问题：代表相似数据的不同潜空间的几何特征是否足以恢复它们之间的对齐？为此，我们提出了HGA（超球面高斯对齐），这是一种通过最大化两个潜空间之间的几何“契合度”度量来直接优化二者之间变换的方法。由于该方法由潜空间自身的几何结构驱动，而非依赖配对数据，HGA可以在无监督和弱监督两种模式下运行。在模型拼接、多语言等任务上……
tldr: 提出了一种名为HGA的潜空间对齐方法，它无需锚点配对数据，仅通过最大化超球面测地线意义上的几何契合度即可实现无监督和弱监督的潜空间对齐。
en_tdlr: HGA is an unsupervised and weakly supervised method that aligns latent spaces of independently trained networks by directly optimizing a geometric fit measure via hyperspherical geodesic matching, eliminating the need for anchored sample correspondences.
